description: In Panoply, a geo-mapped plot of the NOAA OI SST v2 sea surface temperature data (variable 'sst') is currently displayed. Export this plot as a PNG image file. To do this, go to the 'File' menu in the plot window and select 'Export As' or 'Save Image As'. In the save dialog, navigate to the '/home/ga/Documents/PanoplyExports/' directory, enter the filename 'sst_plot.png', make sure the format is set to PNG, and click Save. The exported image should be saved at '/home/ga/Documents/PanoplyExports/sst_plot.png'.

natural_language.prompt: Export the currently displayed sea surface temperature plot as a PNG image to /home/ga/Documents/PanoplyExports/sst_plot.png
